name: socials-input
title: Socials Input
description: A dropdown-based social media URL picker with tag chips and inline URL editing.

migration.guide: Complete redesign. The `t` translation function has been replaced with a simpler `labels` prop. Now uses Dropdown, Tag, Input, and Button registry components instead of raw Headless UI. Social values display as dismissible tag chips instead of individual input rows. Icons switched from react-icons to @remixicon/react.

docs.lead: A dropdown-based social media URL picker with tag chips and inline URL editing. Supports Instagram, X (Twitter), LinkedIn, Facebook, YouTube, TikTok, Zoom, and Calendar.

examples.title: Default
examples.description: Default usage with the 6 main social platforms.

examples.title: With Existing Values
examples.description: Pre-populated with saved social URLs displayed as tags.

examples.title: All Socials
examples.description: Pass null to show all available platforms including Zoom and Calendar.

examples.title: With Form Field
examples.description: Composed with FormField and Label for a complete form layout with asterisk, optional hint, and info tooltip.
examples.code:
<FormField.Root>
  <Label.Root>
    Add your social media
    <Label.Asterisk />
    <Label.Sub>(Optional)</Label.Sub>
    <Label.Info>Add your social media links so others can find you.</Label.Info>
  </Label.Root>
  <SocialsInput
    name="socials"
    formValue={values}
    setFormValue={setValues}
  />
</FormField.Root>

examples.title: Error State
examples.description: Error state with hasError prop and Hint component for form-level validation messages.
examples.code:
<FormField.Root>
  <Label.Root>
    Add your social media
    <Label.Asterisk />
  </Label.Root>
  <SocialsInput
    name="socials"
    hasError
    formValue={values}
    setFormValue={setValues}
  />
  <Hint.Root hasError>
    Please add at least one social media link.
  </Hint.Root>
</FormField.Root>

examples.title: Read Only
examples.description: Read-only mode disables the dropdown and hides dismiss buttons on tags.

examples.title: Custom Labels
examples.code:
<SocialsInput
  name="socials"
  formValue={values}
  setFormValue={setValues}
  labels={{
    placeholder: 'Ajouter un réseau social...',
    errorUrl: 'Veuillez saisir une URL valide',
  }}
/>

props.name: name
props.description: Field name for form integration and error key namespacing.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Disables the dropdown and hides dismiss buttons.

props.name: hasError
props.description: External error state. Applies error ring to the dropdown trigger. Also activates automatically on internal validation errors.

props.name: availableSocials
props.description: Social platforms to show in the dropdown. Pass null for all platforms including Zoom and Calendar.

props.name: formValue
props.description: Current form values as a record of social key to URL.

props.name: setFormValue
props.description: State setter for the form values.

props.name: labels
props.description: Override labels for i18n. Keys: placeholder, errorUrl, errorCalendarUrl, errorZoomUrl.
